extracted.name: No Cook Pretzels with a Kick
extracted.description: Dress up regular pretzels with ranch dressing mix and cayenne pepper for a spicy snack perfect for parties or poker night.
ingredient_lines: 1 (1 ounce) package ranch dressing mix (such as Hidden Valley Ranch ®)
0.5 teaspoon cayenne pepper, or more to taste
instruction_lines: Place vegetable oil, ranch dressing mix, garlic powder, lemon pepper, and cayenne pepper in a gallon-size resealable bag; seal and gently shake to mix oil with dry ingredients. Add pretzels and seal bag; shake to thoroughly coat pretzels with seasoned oil. Let pretzels marinate in the bag for 30 minutes. Shake bag and marinate another 30 minutes. Transfer pretzels to a paper towel-lined baking sheet to dry.
